messages.subject: FixedColumns and Row Selection don't work together
parts:
The selection of rows using the frozen columns, doesn't work.

Run Attached code and try to select rows using the first column.. no numbers are shown at the bottom.
It works if you select rows using other columns

Can this be fixed?
Thanks
Max

library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(data.table)

shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(

    titlePanel("test"),


      mainPanel(
        fluidRow(column(6,
        DT::dataTableOutput("testDT")
        ))
        ,textOutput('text')
      )
  ),
  server = function(input, output, session) {

    bins <-reactive(seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = input$bins + 1))

    output$testDT <- DT::renderDataTable({

          datatable(mtcars
                ,extensions =  c('FixedColumns')
                ,selection=list(mode='multiple')#,'
                ,options=list(
                  fixedColumns = list(leftColumns=1)
                  ,autoWidth = T
                  ,scrollX = TRUE
                  ,columnDefs = list(list(width=100,targets=c(0:ncol(mtcars))))

                )
      )


    })

    output$text  <- renderText({
      input$testDT_rows_selected


    })
  })
